items.exampleEn: Over many years, acid in the rain damaged the old stone statues.
items.exampleZh: 多年來，雨水中的酸損壞了那些古老的石像。

items.exampleEn: The tall basketball player has very long limbs.
items.exampleZh: 那位高個子籃球員四肢很長。

items.exampleEn: The lion opened its huge jaws and yawned.
items.exampleZh: 獅子張開牠巨大的嘴巴，打了個哈欠。

items.exampleEn: Some frogs produce a toxic liquid on their skin to protect themselves.
items.exampleZh: 有些青蛙的皮膚會分泌有毒的液體來保護自己。

items.exampleEn: The boxer finished the match with a bloody nose but a big smile.
items.exampleZh: 那位拳擊手比賽結束時流著鼻血，卻笑得很開心。

items.exampleEn: Modern machines can find a very small tumor inside the body.
items.exampleZh: 現代的儀器可以在體內找到很小的腫瘤。

items.exampleEn: Cyclists usually have very strong thighs.
items.exampleZh: 腳踏車選手的大腿通常都很有力。

items.exampleEn: My pulse raced when I heard my name called on stage.
items.exampleZh: 聽到自己的名字在台上被叫到時，我的心跳加快了。

items.sentenceEn: The factory was closed after it was found dumping toxic waste into the river.
items.sentenceZh: 那間工廠被查到把有毒廢料倒進河裡後就被勒令關閉了。

items.audioEn: Grilled chicken thighs are on sale this week, two packs for the price of one.
items.audioZh: 烤雞腿本週特價，買一送一。

items.sentenceEn: The nurse placed two fingers on my wrist to check my pulse.
items.sentenceZh: 護理師用兩根手指按在我的手腕上量脈搏。

items.sentenceEn: After the long swim, every limb in my body felt heavy.
items.sentenceZh: 長距離游泳之後，我全身四肢都覺得沉重。

items.stemEn: His ____ dropped in surprise when he saw the size of the bill.
items.stemZh: 他看到帳單金額時，驚訝得下巴都掉了。

items.stemEn: Be careful with that cleaning liquid; it is ____ if you breathe it in.
items.stemZh: 那瓶清潔劑要小心，吸進去是有毒的。

items.passageEn: In biology class, we learned how the body works. Our teacher explained that the stomach uses a strong acid to break down food, from pancakes to vegetables. Then she asked us to find our pulse and count it for one minute. Next, we studied the bones in our limbs and learned that the thigh bone is the longest in the human body. The jaw, she said, is the strongest bone in the face. She also mentioned that some cells can form a tumor, which scientists are still researching. Finally, she warned us that many cleaning products are toxic, so we should always read the labels. One student joked that the lesson was less bloody than he had expected.
items.passageZh: 生物課上，我們學了人體如何運作。老師解釋，胃會用很強的酸來分解食物，從鬆餅到蔬菜都一樣。接著她要我們找到自己的脈搏，數一分鐘。然後我們研究四肢的骨頭，學到大腿骨是人體最長的骨頭。她說，下顎是臉部最強壯的骨頭。她也提到有些細胞會形成腫瘤，科學家仍在研究這件事。最後，她提醒我們很多清潔用品是有毒的，所以一定要看標示。有個同學開玩笑說，這堂課沒有他想像中那麼血腥。

questions.questionZh: 人體最長的骨頭是哪一根？
老師為什麼提醒大家看標示？
options: 因為很多食物很快就會過期

items.promptZh: 這種果汁含有很多酸，喝起來很酸。
referenceEn: This juice contains a lot of acid, so it tastes very sour.
There is a lot of acid in this juice, so it is very sour.
rubricZh: acid 當名詞是「酸」，不可數（例如 a lot of acid）
「很酸」可寫 very sour 等（寫 acidic 也正確）；可寫 contains… 或 there is… in 等

items.instructionZh: 用 thigh 造一個句子，說說運動時哪裡會酸，或你喜歡的雞腿料理。
referenceEn: My thighs always hurt the day after I go hiking.
I like chicken thighs better than chicken breasts.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 thigh 或 thighs
